enabled.label: Enable face checks
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the plugin never touches the camera and the idle chain runs unmodified.

camera_path.label: Camera device
camera_path.description: Video device path such as /dev/video0. Leave empty to auto-detect. When set, it overrides Camera mode and this exact camera is checked.

camera_mode.label: Camera mode
camera_mode.description: Which sensor to check: visible light, infrared, an ambient-light decision per check (dark uses IR), or both sensors with a face on either keeping the session awake.

ir_threshold_lux.label: IR switch threshold (lux)
ir_threshold_lux.description: Smart mode only: below this ambient light level the IR camera is used, at or above it the RGB camera. The ambient sensor is read once per check.

detector.label: Detector
detector.description: haar is cheap and runs on a small grayscale frame; dnn is more accurate but needs assets/face-dnn.onnx and more CPU.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: 1 is lenient (more false faces, session stays awake more easily), 10 is strict. Applies to both detectors.

capture_width.label: Capture width
capture_width.description: Frame width in pixels for each check; height follows 4:3. Detection runs on a 320 px-wide downscale regardless, so this mainly trades camera bandwidth.

cooldown_s.label: Spawn cooldown
cooldown_s.description: Minimum seconds between gate runs, bounding camera wake-ups if idle triggers stack up.

debug_log.label: Debug log
debug_log.description: Write the helper's activity log to the plugin data directory. Off by default; the log records verdicts and camera details, never images.
